visual.general_description: Actigraphy figure for case 3 with 24-h actograms and rest/activity ratio with sample entropy plots for each recording.
visual.detailed_description: Panel a: Grey hatched blocks at both ends. Black vertical activity lines are mostly short and low throughout, with several tall isolated spikes and a few tall lines near both ends of the monitored stretch. Panel b: Solid line is a high plateau, falls steeply to a trough, rises again to a high plateau, then falls to a long low stretch with small bumps and rises once more to a plateau before the right grey block. The dotted line starts with several tall narrow peaks, falls to low values, rises to a broad hump during the second plateau, stays low across the low stretch and shows a final hump. Panel c: Grey block at the left end and a wider grey block at the right end. A continuous dense band of black activity lines fills the whole monitored time, with a denser patch in the first part and many tall isolated spikes, two of them much taller than the rest. Panel d: Solid line stays as a high plateau with only slight dips across the whole monitored time. The dotted line fluctuates continuously with many separate peaks and troughs and does not settle to a low stretch.
